## What happened

A clear, short description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to ...
2. Ask DHRUV / click ...

What should have happened instead.

## What actually happened

What happened instead. If this is about a DHRUV answer, paste the question you asked and the answer state shown: `VERIFIED`, `AMBIGUOUS`, or `UNVERIFIED`.

## Sources (for answer errors)

If DHRUV gave a wrong or outdated answer, link the official source document (`gov.in` / `nic.in`) that has the current rule, and note the date it changed if you know it.
